# Sahkarmi

> Sahkarmi (सहकर्मी, "coworker") is a free, open-source desktop app (Apache License 2.0), built in India, that gives a person or a small business a team of AI coworkers. Each coworker has its own workspace, browser, memory and task queue, and asks the owner before payments, customer messages, publishing or form submissions. Tagline: "Your AI team. Made in India."

Key facts (verified against release 0.21.0 on 3 November 2026):

- Product category: AI coworker / AI agent desktop app. Local-first: coworkers, chats, files and settings are stored on the user's computer; there is no Sahkarmi cloud account and the app sends no analytics. Its only outbound traffic of its own is the update check against GitHub Releases.
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) is the released and tested build. Windows ARM and 32-bit systems are not supported.
- Price: free. No pricing, no account, no subscription. Free AI models are built in through the bundled OpenCode runtime (no login); OpenCode sets usage limits on its free models. Optional: reuse existing sign-ins of Codex CLI (ChatGPT) and Claude Code on the same computer, or connect Google Antigravity with Log in with Google or an API key; paid plans are billed by those providers, not by Sahkarmi.
- Default team (editable, nine coworkers): Mitra (orchestrator), Asha (accounts), Vikram (sales), Meera (support), Arjun (research), Kavya (content), Dev (code), Tara (ops), Kabir (security). Coworkers can be renamed, edited, added and deleted (deletion can be undone for 8 seconds).
- Features: built-in Chromium browser tab per coworker with a "Take over" button for logins and OTPs; Approvals inbox; task queue with pause, cancel and stop; schedules (once, hourly, daily, weekdays, weekly) and routines; Shared files folder; memory page; search across coworkers and messages (Ctrl+K); keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+1 to 9, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+,); backup model (a paid provider that answers nothing or hits its quota falls back to the free model); interface in English, Hindi and Bengali, plus nine more Indian languages partly translated (Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese) with English fallback; light (Paper) and dark (Night) themes; three interface sizes; voice notes.
- Knowledge Bases (local RAG): the owner makes a knowledge base on the Knowledge page and adds PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, Markdown, text, JSON or HTML files, or whole folders. Files are split into passages and indexed on the computer in a SQLite FTS5 full-text index (BM25, stemmed); nothing is uploaded. Coworkers allowed on a base get the best passages with every message and cite them as [S1], [S2] (page, slide, sheet or heading); citations open the file. Coworkers also have search and read tools. Optional "Smarter search": one static embedding model (potion-base-8M by The Minish Lab, MIT, about 30 MB) downloaded once from huggingface.co and run in plain TypeScript on the computer; passages get int8 vectors, searches fuse cosine and BM25 rankings. No cloud embeddings.
- Team runs (Multi-Agent page): one goal for the whole team is split into tasks; each task goes to a coworker through its normal queue, so permissions and approvals apply; the run is a durable LangGraph state graph with a checkpoint after every step, pauses for approvals and resumes after a restart from the last finished step. Runs can be exported as Markdown, text or JSON.
- Status: development preview. Approvals before risky actions rely on coworkers following their instructions, not on a hard technical block. The Windows installer is not code-signed yet (SmartScreen warning); every release publishes SHA-256 checksums, an SBOM and a GitHub build provenance attestation.
- Technology: Electron and SolidJS, TypeScript. Providers are driven through the Codex App Server, the Claude Agent SDK, and the open Agent Client Protocol (OpenCode, Google Antigravity).
- Licence: Apache License 2.0. Developed by the Sahkarmi Team. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.

## Official links

- [Website](https://sahkarmi.site/): product overview, explainer video, real screenshots, download and FAQ
- [Install guide](https://sahkarmi.site/install.html): Windows steps, checksum verification, provider setup, updates, troubleshooting, uninstall
- [AI savings calculator](https://sahkarmi.site/savings.html): estimate hours saved, the value of that time, and whether a paid ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI or GitHub Copilot plan beats free tools; India prices checked 29/10/2026, runs in the browser
- [Get started](https://sahkarmi.site/docs.html): first launch, connecting an AI provider, creating a coworker, giving it work, the built-in browser and approvals, Telegram chat, updates, where data lives
- [Changelog](https://sahkarmi.site/changelog.html): release notes for every version, linked to each GitHub release
- [Privacy policy](https://sahkarmi.site/privacy.html): what the app stores on the computer, what it sends and to whom, what the website collects, how to delete data
- [Terms of use](https://sahkarmi.site/terms.html): Apache License 2.0 summary, no warranty, owner responsibility for AI coworkers, no affiliation with AI companies
- [Download (GitHub Releases)](https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/sahakarmi/releases/latest): Windows installer, checksums, SBOM and provenance attestation
- [itch.io page](https://sahkarmisite.itch.io/sahkarmi): the same Windows installer, also listed on itch.io
- [Source code](https://github.com/ganguydhrubo/sahakarmi): GitHub repository, issues, contributing guide, security policy, privacy notes
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sahkarmi/): official company page
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sahakarmi): official page
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/sahkarmiai): official account (@sahkarmiai)
